ValidationRule.description: Freight - If “IATA Agent” is selected as the Agent Type then mandatory to enter IATA#
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( New_Account_Type__c, "Freight-Branch") , ISPICKVAL( Freight_Agent_Type__c , "IATA Agent"), (ISBLANK( IATA__c )), NOT ( $Profile.Name = 'System Administrator'), NOT ( $Profile.Name = 'Qantas System Administrator'), NOT ( $Profile.Name = 'Qantas System Admin - Freight'), NOT ( $Profile.Name = 'Qantas System Admin - QCC'), NOT ( $Profile.Name = 'Qantas System Admin - SND'))
